description: This file defines the AlbumArtCache class, a singleton responsible for caching album artwork images in an Android media browsing application. It manages an LRU cache of bitmaps, supports asynchronous loading of images from URLs, rescaling, and provides methods to fetch, retrieve, and cache album art efficiently.

classes.name: AlbumArtCache
classes.description: A singleton class that manages an LRU cache for album art bitmaps, supports async fetching, and provides access to cached images.

classes.name: AlbumArtCache.FetchListener
classes.description: An abstract callback class for handling completion events when an album art image has been fetched or an error occurred.

methods.name: AlbumArtCache.getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of AlbumArtCache.

methods.name: AlbumArtCache.getBigImage
methods.description: Retrieves the high-resolution album art bitmap for a given URL from the cache.

methods.name: AlbumArtCache.getIconImage
methods.description: Retrieves the scaled icon-sized album art bitmap for a given URL from the cache.

methods.name: AlbumArtCache.fetch
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches album art from a URL, resizes it, caches it, and notifies a listener upon completion.
